description: This file defines a Printer struct and associated functions for formatted output, including support for JSON and plain text, templating, paging, and error handling within the Mattermost CLI project.

classes.name: Printer
classes.description: A struct for managing output formatting, templating, paging, and error reporting in CLI commands.

methods.name: SetFormat
methods.description: Sets the output format (plain or JSON).

methods.name: SetCommand
methods.description: Associates a cobra.Command with the printer for context-aware output.

methods.name: SetServerAddres
methods.description: Sets the server address for contextual output.

methods.name: SetNoNewline
methods.description: Prevents adding a newline at the end of output.

methods.name: SetTemplateFunc
methods.description: Adds a custom function for templating.

methods.name: SetSingle
methods.description: Sets whether to print a single item without list formatting.

methods.name: PrintT
methods.description: Prints an item using a specified template and format.

methods.name: PrintPreparedT
methods.description: Prints a precompiled template with data.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints an item with default formatting.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Outputs all accumulated lines, handling paging and statistics.

methods.name: Clean
methods.description: Resets the accumulated lines and errors.

methods.name: PrintError
methods.description: Adds an error message to the error lines.
